# AFRERA Engineering Registry

**Generated by:** `tools/engineering-registry.js`
**Regenerate:** `node tools/engineering-registry.js`
**CI check:** `node tools/engineering-registry.js --check`

---

## Why these are generated, not written

Governance directive 11 requires: *"Auto-update all registries after every
implementation. No manual synchronization allowed."*

A hand-authored registry breaks that rule the moment it is saved. Within a week
it describes a system that no longer exists — the exact failure already
documented in `../EBDESIGN_ALIGNMENT.md`, where 450 KB of aspirational specs at
the repo root were read as a gap list and caused duplicate work.

So every file here is **derived from the code**. If a registry disagrees with
the code, the registry is wrong; regenerating fixes it. That is the only
arrangement that satisfies directive 11 honestly.

**Do not edit these files by hand.** Change the code, or change the generator.

## Gap classification

The taxonomy from directive 4, applied automatically by tracing five links per
capability (DB, API, Service, UI, Test):

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Missing** | No link present anywhere |
| **Database Only** | Schema exists, nothing uses it |
| **Backend Only (no schema)** | Service exists with no persistence |
| **Backend Complete / Frontend Missing** | DB + API + Service present, no UI |
| **Testing Pending** | Everything but tests |
| **Partially Implemented** | Mixed |
| **Production Candidate** | All five links present |

`Backend Complete / Frontend Missing` is the most useful of these. It is the
largest single category in this repo, and it is a *far* more tractable problem
than "not started" — the schema and business logic already exist and work.

---

## What the generator does NOT do

Stated plainly so this is not mistaken for complete coverage:

- **Does not run the code.** It reads source. A route that exists but throws at
  runtime counts as present here. Boot verification is separate.
- **Capability tracing is regex-based.** The 26 capabilities are hand-defined in
  the generator. A capability not in that list is invisible to the registry.
  One false positive was already found and fixed (a `/Price/i` pattern matched
  any component containing "Price" and reported a UI link for a capability with
  no backend at all).
- **Does not measure quality.** It counts endpoints, not whether they are
  correct, fast, or secure.
- **Does not cover:** Volumes 1–12, knowledge/NKOII, ERP form inventory,
  security audit (OWASP/PCI DSS), or the 1,500-submodule inventory.

To extend it, add to the `CAPABILITIES` array in
`tools/engineering-registry.js` — the tracing, classification, gap register and
dashboard all update from that one list.
